messages:
tasha: Hi team — my 04/30 net pay is $480 less than expected. I see a deduction called 'STATE RECOVERY - OR' for $240 and a separate 'HMRC PAYE ADJUST' for \u00a3120. I was on a 3-month secondment to the UK (Jan-Mar) and returned 2026-04-01. I didn't get any notices.
hr_payroll: Sorry to see that, @tasha. Please DM your April paystub and your UK final payslip (P45 or final payslip). Don't post SSN here. We'll triage with Payroll Ops.
tasha: DM sent (paystub + P45).
payroll-bot: Payroll run #202604 completed; year-to-date files submitted.
payroll_ops: Thanks @tasha. Two things could be happening: (1) a state-level recovery (OR) for prior-year underwithholding, (2) an HMRC reclaim posted after your UK payroll finalization. We'll pull recovery notices and the UK posting date.
global_tax: If HMRC reclaimed PAYE after employer finalized payroll, we can attempt an employer-led reclaim or advise employee claim steps. For OR recovery, need to see the notice source — could be another employer or a state offset.
hr_payroll: Plan: 1) Payroll Ops to fetch recovery/notice details and confirm case number origin 2) Global Tax to check HMRC posting and reclaim eligibility 3) If either deduction is erroneous, we'll reverse and reimburse on next payroll and document tax/reporting impacts 4) Update you within 5 business days. Does that work?
tasha: Works for me — thanks. One question: will refunds come through payroll or as separate checks? I'm on a personal UK bank account for part of the year.
global_tax: Prefer payroll refund (so it's on record) when employer can secure HMRC credit. If HMRC refunds directly to employee we can coordinate. We'll confirm after we see the reclaim route.
finance_ops: Noted. If we refund through payroll, we'll include any bank fees/interest. Also we'll evaluate whether W-2/W-2c or local reporting is needed for corrections.
payroll_ops: Actioning now — pulling state remittance logs and UK payroll ledger. @payroll-bot create investigation ticket.
payroll-bot: Ticket PAY-2026-517 created: "Investigate OR recovery + HMRC PAYE adjust for Tasha" (linked to thread 1801239123). Sensitive docs saved to People Ops secure bucket (access: payroll/legal/people-ops/global-tax).
hr_payroll: Tasha — please upload any UK correspondence you received and confirm whether you maintained a UK bank account for the Feb-Mar payroll. That will speed reclaim routing.
tasha: Uploaded emails from payroll and confirm I used my UK account for Feb only. Thanks everyone.
hr_payroll: Received. We'll post interim findings by EOD +5 business days. Apologies for the inconvenience.
tasha: Appreciate the help 64f"
